title: Up to 3.2x Faster Inference with LFM2.5-DSpark
summary: LiquidAI 发布 LFM2.5-DSpark，通过稀疏注意力机制和动态推理优化，在保持模型质量的同时实现最高 3.2 倍的推理加速，适用于长上下文和高吞吐场景。
highlights: Up to 3.2x faster inference compared to dense baselines
Sparse attention mechanism reduces computational complexity
Maintains model quality while improving throughput
Optimized for long-context and high-throughput applications
